name: Bridge Prep: rho_AB Joint Density Matrix Construction

pytorch.reason: load_bearing: rho_A ⊗ rho_B via torch.kron; Von Neumann entropy and mutual information I(A;B) computed via torch.linalg.eigvalsh; autograd on I(A;B) w.r.t. coupling parameter lambda

pyg.reason: not needed -- no graph-native dynamics in this density matrix construction

z3.reason: load_bearing: UNSAT proof that I(A;B) < 0 is structurally impossible (information inequality -- mutual information is always non-negative)

cvc5.reason: not needed -- z3 covers the UNSAT proof; cvc5 crosscheck deferred to canonical upgrade

sympy.reason: load_bearing: symbolic partial trace Tr_B(rho_A ⊗ rho_B) = rho_A verified for a generic 2x2 ⊗ 2x2 product state

clifford.reason: load_bearing: Cl(6,0) = Cl(3,0) ⊗ Cl(3,0) tensor product; product state corresponds to grade-separable multivectors; coupling = grade entanglement between the two Cl(3,0) factors

geomstats.reason: not needed -- no manifold geodesic computation at this baseline level

e3nn.reason: not needed -- equivariant layer not required for density matrix construction

rustworkx.reason: load_bearing: bipartite coupling graph with shell_A and shell_B nodes; product state has no edges; coupled state has edges; edge count tracks the degree of shell coupling

xgi.reason: load_bearing: 4-way hyperedge {rho_A, rho_B, rho_AB, I_AB} encoding that mutual information is a relational property of both shells and their joint state

toponetx.reason: not needed -- no cell-complex topology at this prep level

gudhi.reason: not needed -- no filtration or persistence required here

P1_product_state_is_valid_density_matrix.note: rho_A ⊗ rho_B must be positive, Hermitian, trace=1

P2_product_state_mutual_info_zero.note: I(A;B) = S(A) + S(B) - S(AB) = 0 for product state

P3_coupled_state_mutual_info_positive.note: Non-product coupled state must have I(A;B) > 0

P4_partial_trace_recovers_rho_A.note: Tr_B(rho_A ⊗ rho_B) = rho_A must hold exactly

P5_partial_trace_recovers_rho_B.note: Tr_A(rho_A ⊗ rho_B) = rho_B must hold exactly

P7_autograd_I_wrt_lambda.note: Autograd confirms I(A;B) is differentiable w.r.t. coupling lambda

P8_product_entropy_additive.note: S(A ⊗ B) = S(A) + S(B) for product state

N1_product_state_equals_tensor_product.note: Product state has zero coupling residual; coupled state would have nonzero

N2_z3_unsat_negative_mutual_info.note: UNSAT: I(A;B) < 0 is structurally impossible given non-negative entropies and subadditivity

N3_sympy_partial_trace_identity.note: Symbolic Tr_B(rho_A ⊗ rho_B) = rho_A when Tr(rho_B)=1 -- verified in sympy

N4_coupled_state_departs_from_product.note: Coupled state must differ from product state

N5_coupling_strictly_increases_mutual_in.note: Coupling must strictly increase mutual information beyond product baseline

N6_rustworkx_product_has_no_edges_couple.note: Bipartite coupling graph: product=no edges, coupled=edges present

B1_lambda_zero_is_product_state.note: At lam=0, coupled state collapses to product; I=0

B2_clifford_product_grade_separable.note: Cl(6,0) product multivector is grade-separable; coupling introduces extra grade structure

B3_xgi_4way_hyperedge_encodes_mutual_inf.note: xgi hyperedge {rho_A, rho_B, rho_AB, I_AB} encodes 4-way relational structure

B4_so3_embedding_boundary_real_product_s.note: At SO(3)→U(3) embedding, rho_AB is real (block-diagonal in real/imag sense)

B5_mutual_info_symmetric.note: I(A;B) = I(B;A) -- mutual information is symmetric (verified by SWAP permutation)
